title: Recipe book and shopping list
goal: Turn the page into a recipe book with a shopping list. To write a recipe there is a text input with the placeholder "Recipe name", a text input with the placeholder "Ingredient", a text input with the placeholder "Quantity" (a whole number) and a button labelled "Add ingredient", which adds the ingredient to the recipe being written, shown as "QUANTITY x INGREDIENT", and clears the ingredient and quantity inputs. A button labelled "Save recipe" stores the recipe with its ingredients and clears the form. Saved recipes are listed as "NAME (K ingredients)", each with a button labelled "Plan NAME" that adds the recipe's ingredients to the shopping list on the server: an ingredient already on the list gets the quantities added together, a new one goes to the end. The section headed "Shopping list" shows each item as "INGREDIENT: QUANTITY", or "List is empty", and a button labelled "Clear list" removes every item. Recipes are stored as `Recipe` nodes connected to root, with a field `name: str`; each ingredient is an `Ingredient` node with fields `name: str` and `quantity: int`, connected to its recipe, not to root. Shopping list items are `ListItem` nodes connected to root, with fields `name: str` and `quantity: int`. Stored recipes and the shopping list are shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
